Install gridcraft on Omarchy

Clean-room spreadsheet in pure Rust that opens and saves Excel workbooks

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add gridcraft-bin
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.13.0-1:
    pacman -Qi gridcraft-bin

Open and use gridcraft

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

pacman -Ql gridcraft-bin

Frequently asked questions

How do I install gridcraft on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add gridcraft-bin. The download is 45.8 MB and it takes 98.8 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is gridcraft free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed Apache-2.0 OR MIT, OFL-1.1.

How do I uninstall gridcraft?

Run omarchy pkg drop gridcraft-bin. It removes the package from your system.

What does gridcraft depend on?

The package declares 9 dependencies: glibc, libgcc, dbus, libxcb, libxkbcommon, libxkbcommon-x11, wayland, vulkan-icd-loader, hicolor-icon-theme. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is gridcraft in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as gridcraft-bin (version 0.13.0-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. storytold makes it. Project site: https://github.com/storytold/gridcraft.
